Garden notes for spring

A short plan for the vegetable beds, written in March.

What to plant first

The soil warms slowly in the north bed, so the hardy crops go there first. Onions and peas can go in as soon as the ground can be worked.

  • Onion sets, two rows along the fence
  • Snap peas on the trellis
  • Spinach between the onion rows

Timing

CropSowHarvest
OnionsLate MarchJuly
PeasEarly AprilJune
SpinachEarly AprilMay

Water the new rows every other morning until the seedlings are up.

More ideas are in the community garden guide.
